title: TCG:SAS-174

power.text:
All heroes in this zone get "Push the Argo - Exhaust Action: Put the Argo 1 zone forward."
When the Argo is pushed by a hero with 3 DEF or less, put 2 +1 ATK and +1 DEF counters on that hero.
